title: How are you feeling? — новые слова

items.example: I've had a headache all morning.
items.mnemonic: Голова болит эдак с самого утра — I've had a headache, головную боль.

items.example: She stayed home because she had a sore throat.
items.mnemonic: Сор застрял в горле — she had a sore throat, боль в горле.

items.example: He can't stop coughing — he's had a bad cough for a week.
items.mnemonic: Кашляет над кофе неделю — he's had a bad cough, кашель.

items.example: The nurse took my temperature and said I had a fever.
items.mnemonic: Лежит как фанера с жаром — said I had a fever, лихорадку.

items.example: I've got a runny nose and I keep sneezing.
items.mnemonic: Ранний насморк и чихание — I've got a runny nose, насморк.

items.example: Eating too much chocolate gave me a stomach ache.
items.mnemonic: Стакан шоколада — и боль: gave me a stomach ache, боль в животе.

items.example: Sitting at a desk all day causes back pain.
items.mnemonic: Бэк-вокалист согнулся — sitting causes back pain, боль в спине.

items.example: The child was crying because of an earache.
items.mnemonic: Ирокез болит в ухе — crying because of an earache, боль в ухе.

items.example: I felt dizzy after standing up too quickly.
items.mnemonic: Голова гудит как дизель — I felt dizzy, головокружение.

items.example: The bumpy car ride caused nausea.
items.mnemonic: Нытьё от ухабистой дороги — the ride caused nausea, тошноту.

items.example: She developed a rash after eating shellfish.
items.mnemonic: Рожь с морепродуктами дала сыпь — developed a rash, сыпь.

items.example: The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.
items.mnemonic: Скрипка выписала антибиотики — gave me a prescription, рецепт.

items.example: You can buy painkillers at the pharmacy.
items.mnemonic: Фарш с обезболивающим — buy painkillers at the pharmacy, в аптеке.

items.example: Common symptoms of a cold include a runny nose and a sore throat.
items.mnemonic: Симптомы простуды налицо — common symptoms: насморк и боль в горле.
